Pastor Patrick Anwuzia , GENERAL OVERSEER OF ZOE MINISTRIES WORLWIDE.

4d 2 min read Latunde Akin

Pastor Patrick Anwuzia , GENERAL OVERSEER OF ZOE MINISTRIES WORLWIDE.
A man of many miracles and deliverance.
A man God used mightily to fill stadiums in the 90s and early 2000.
A man with flowing agbadas and flowing anointing.
A man that took over the television ministry and widely demonstrated acts of God .
A man we the SU of those days tagged backsliided or extravagant.
Suddenly he disappeared from the public ministry.
In our intercessory prayer meeting last week we remembered to intercede for him for three days.
We remembered him and were moved to plead to God on his behalf for great mercy to finish well.
We are not after the controversies surrounding his disappearance from public eye. Our concern is purely to lift him up in prayers.
Many Genzs may not know him,but those who were born in the 90s or early 2000.
The church soon forget supposedly fallen soldiers or men who laboured in the past for God.
We thank God for the man of God,he is still in ministry in a very private way.
I believe he has many lessons to teach younger generations on how not to fall victim of the onslaught of the devils.
May God help him end well in Jesus name.
You too can join our intercessory prayer group. HAVE COMPASSION INTERCESSORY TEAM. We pray every night at 10pm for souls. You can message me inbox.
God bless you.
Your brother ,
Latunde Akin
